one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent produced a functionally runnable script that converted masks to polylines but never implemented the required non-overlap enforcement across instances, and accepted the successful execution as full task completion without verifying this constraint.
t_err_evidence: The script written at step 1 processes each mask independently via SAM bounding-box prediction and contour extraction but contains no inter-instance suppression (e.g., pixel-wise argmax or mask subtraction) to prevent overlapping polyline regions across cells — the core missing requirement.
t_commit_evidence: The same logically incomplete script design (no overlap enforcement) is carried forward in the step 11 rewrite and executed without modification in steps 19-21; no version of the script with overlap handling is ever created, locking in the failing outcome from the first write.
trigger_explanation: The task specification requires non-overlapping masks (pixel-wise exclusivity across cell instances), but the agent never reads or addresses this requirement. From step 1 onward, the implementation treats each cell independently without any post-processing to resolve overlaps, indicating the constraint was simply dropped or never noticed.
